name: shotkit
description: Marketplace for the shotkit plugin — portable cinematic prompt craft.

plugins.name: shotkit
plugins.description: Cinematic prompt craft for any t2i/t2v generator: cinematic-scenes (grounded shot direction), pov-scenes (subjective camera), short-drama-structure (retention beats), character-refs (role-labelled references and looks), prompt-assembly (the finished prompt and its reference order).
